name: Ashdod
registryCustodian: Ashdod Municipality, Engineering Administration / municipal GIS
queryAndRequestOutcome: Separate English and Hebrew first-party discovery found the municipal ArcGIS REST directory and parcel service. Service metadata and layer schema were inspected. An anonymous exact-point intersects request, using EPSG:2039 coordinates derived from the immutable WUP point, returned one WGS84 Polygon with Gush 2068 and Helka 199. No unsafe fields were requested.
scopeLimits: The exact-point result is one bounded query, not a citywide parcel extract.
A hit at the exact point does not prove all Ashdod parcels are publicly available.
The WUP point [31.7987303087695,34.65004462462] was preserved in latitude/longitude order and not shifted.
The service does not establish production adapter quality, update cadence, or countrywide coverage.
sourceSpecificFields: The parcel layer exposes OBJECTID, Helka, Gush, Helka_Area and geometry. The native parcel identity is recorded as the Gush+Helka composite (2068/199), with OBJECTID 6473 as the source OID; raw source attributes are not retained in a sample.
compositeKeyProvenance: Gush=2068 + Helka=199 from the same returned native feature; OBJECTID=6473 is the service OID cross-check.
qualification: Not qualified for runtime integration or admission; serial reviewer must independently verify URL stability, CRS handling, field mapping, and safe identifier choice.
uncertainty: Full unchanged response geometry is retained only in ignored tmp/valhalla-parcel-research/285/exact.geojson. No credentials, private tokens, owner/address data, or unsafe fields were used.
